run_ade_corpus_preprocessing: run the AdeCorpusV2_Effect dataset preprocessing script to generate k-shot data for multiple random seeds
create_ade_corpus_dataset: create an AdeCorpusV2_Effect dataset instance that loads the ADE corpus v2 drug-ade relation data from HuggingFace
build_k_shot_data: build k-shot training, development, and test splits from the ADE corpus dataset using configurable seed values
review_get_train_test_lines: review the get_train_test_lines method that splits the dataset into 80 percent train and 20 percent test sets
summarize_map_hf_dataset_to_list: summarize the map_hf_dataset_to_list method that transforms HuggingFace datapoints into text-drug-effect tuples
